processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Three low-density steel grades (including 15Mn5Ni) were prepared by vacuum induction melting route; a 30 kg ingot was produced and its sound portion was used.
Sound portion of the 30 kg ingot homogenized at 1423 K for 2.5 h.
Hot rolled at 1323 K; final thickness of hot rolled plate about 13 mm. This condition is referred to as HR.

Samples cut from hot-rolled plates were cold rolled at room temperature to ~50% reduction in thickness (~6 mm thick sheets) in several passes; 15Mn5Ni cracked beyond 50% cold reduction so further reduction was not carried out. The cold rolled condition is denoted HR+CR.

processing_steps.method: heat treatment at 873 K followed by water quenching
processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Cold rolled sheets were heat treated in the temperature range 873 K–1273 K for 1 h followed by water quenching; heat-treated samples are referred to by the heat treatment temperature. This sample corresponds to the 873 K condition, which is documented for hardness only.

defects.type: annealing twins (lower fraction than higher-Mn LDS alloys)

phases_present.morphology: elongated stringers (bamboo-like morphology) and polygonal particles

defects.type: planar slip bands (parallel slip bands); no deformation twinning or martensite transformation

phases_present.morphology: deformed, with parallel planar slip bands
elongated stringers that underwent concurrent deformation with austenite; average thickness reduced from ~8 μm to ~2 μm and eventually sheared and fragmented (~35–45° to rolling direction)

microstructure_list.region: bulk (cold-rolled sheet, precursor state to 873 K heat treatment)

structures.overall_structure: Fe–15Mn–9Al-0.9C–5Ni (15Mn5Ni) is a Ni-containing lower-Mn austenitic low-density steel whose microstructure consists of a γ-austenite matrix together with ordered B2 (Fe(Ni)Al-type) phase and κ-carbide precipitates; in the hot-rolled (HR) condition the B2 fraction (~12%) is higher than in the higher-Mn 28Mn5Ni alloy (~4%), and the alloy possesses the highest κ-carbide volume fraction among the three alloys.
